auditor_exposure: Auditor was original image-side observer; independent code replay, not a third blind expert. Both four-panel inputs released after freezes. No f67 word-boundary task outputs read.
method: Independent implementation; original generator never imported or run. Exact Fraction metrics, full Cartesian membership, directed cyclic adjacency, geometric center order, source-line identity hashes. No text similarity, semantics, meanings, or scores.
code_review: compare_v1.py manually inspected: geometry construction reads coordinate, role, band, identifier and cycle fields; no source raw_line/raw_body strings read for candidate choice or ordering; no maximum-IoU winner selected.

findings.detail: Original comparison reports mutual-unique and cyclic diagnostics for coarse text only. Audit additionally derives fine/object/ring mutual candidates and object cycles without changing original results.
f72r1.10 intersects both outer ZO07 and inner ZI05. Cross-ring extra area 1200 px2 is retained, leaving both affected coarse cycles incomplete.
All 71 locators retain both original raw lines (142 exact source-line checks). Opaque equality is preservation verification, not word matching.
Three panels have full coarse cyclic agreement in both rings; no panel has full fine mutual coverage across both rings. This does not pass the complete text/body gate.

object_cycle_supplement.limit: Supplement, not a claim made by original compare_v1.py; ring membership exposed through guided record metadata. No text-object ownership inferred.

limitations: Rectangle intersection is candidate geometry only; neither same word nor object ownership.
Guided source-locator order remains guidance-exposed, even where box-center cyclic order agrees.
Coarse full cycles do not establish fine-unit cycles or historical reading order.
Ring disk envelopes overlap across all rings and cannot identify ring ink.
Independent arithmetic does not re-observe or certify hand-drawn boxes.
